the-couple-next-door.title: The Couple Next Door
the-couple-next-door.synopsis: ينتقل زوجان شابان إلى حي راقي لبدء حياة عائلية، ولكنهما سرعان ما يعلقان داخل شبكة معقدة من الرغبة والخيانة مع جيرانهما الجدد.

mayans-m-c.title: Mayans M.C.
mayans-m-c.synopsis: يخرج الصبي (إي زد رييس) من السجن بسبب سريان اتفاقية مبرمة بخصوص الحدود بين ولاية كاليفورنيا ودولة المكسيك، بحيث يجب عليه تغيير هويته بهوية جديدة تمكنه من بدء حياة جديدة بعيدة عن السجن.

non-ci-resta-che-il-crimine.title: Non ci resta che il crimine
non-ci-resta-che-il-crimine.titleEn: Non ci resta che il crimine
non-ci-resta-che-il-crimine.originalTitle: Non ci resta che il crimine

supergirl.title: Supergirl
supergirl.synopsis: كارا زور إيل، البالغة من العمر أربعة وعشرين عامًا، والتي تبنتها عائلة دانفر عندما كانت في سن الثالثه عشر، بعد أن تم ارسالها من كوكب كريبتون، والان وجب عليها ان تستخدم قواتها الخارقه بعد أن أخفتها طول المدة السابقة. تكشف كارا قوتها خلال كارثة غير متوقعة، وتضعها في رحلة الى البطولية.

blindspot.title: Blindspot
blindspot.synopsis: يُعثر على فتاة عارية في حقيبة بساحة "التايمز" لا تتذكر من هي ولا من أين أو كيف أتت!، وجسمها كله مغطى بوشوم غامضة ولكن هناك وشم لا يمكن تجاهله يحمل اسم عميل المباحث الفيدرالية "كورت ويلر".

sunny.title: Sunny
sunny.synopsis: حياة امرأة أمريكية تعيش في "كيوتو"، "اليابان" تنقلب رأساً على عقب عندما يختفي زوجها وابنها في تحطم طائرة غامض. لتعزيتها، تحصل على "صاني"، أحد الروبوتات المنزلية الجديدة التي تصنعها شركة زوجها للأ.

أملي-الأخير-metruk-adam-2025.title: Metruk Adam
أملي-الأخير-metruk-adam-2025.synopsis: بعد قضاء فترة عقوبة في السجن بسبب جريمة ارتكبها شقيقه، يجتمع رجل مع عائلته بحذر، ليجد الأمل والتشافي في علاقة تغير حياته مع ابنة أخيه.

الحب-مجرد-لحظة-ask-sadece-bir-an-2025.title: Ask Sadece Bir An
الحب-مجرد-لحظة-ask-sadece-bir-an-2025.originalTitle: الحب مجرد لحظة Ask Sadece Bir An 2025
الحب-مجرد-لحظة-ask-sadece-bir-an-2025.synopsis: A young man and woman from very different backgrounds fall in love but their relationship faces obstacles from his troubled past and her overprotective parents.

tunnels-sun-in-the-dark-2025.title: Tunnels: Sun in the Dark
tunnels-sun-in-the-dark-2025.synopsis: In 1967, as the Vietnam War raged, a Vietnamese revolutionary guerrilla team became the U.S. military's top target—charged with safeguarding a secret group of intelligence agents at all costs.

once-we-were-us-2025.title: Once We Were Us
once-we-were-us-2025.synopsis: Seoul, 2008. On a bus heading to their hometown, fate brings Eun-ho and Jeong-won together, sparking an unlikely friendship. While battling  a bustling and weary city life, they find themselves sharing lofty dreams and a love that comes to feel extraordinary. But, eventually, the harsh realities of life lead them to part ways. Over a decade after the separation, the two unexpectedly reunite on a flight back to Korea, where they reflect on their lost time.

munkar-2024.title: Munkar
munkar-2024.synopsis: An oddity that caused unrest at an Islamic boarding school occurred since one of the female students returned. What's really going on?

eye-for-an-eye-2-2024.title: Eye for an Eye 2
eye-for-an-eye-2-2024.synopsis: The blind swordsman, skilled in martial arts, named Cheng Xiazi (Xie Miao), accidentally saves Zhang Xiaoyu (Yang Enyou), who has suffered from the destruction of his family. Under the persuasion of the orphan Xiaoyu, Cheng reluctantly keeps him by his side and teaches him skills. Xiaoyu also waits for the opportunity to seek revenge.

smugglers-2023.title: Smugglers
smugglers-2023.synopsis: فيلم حركة وجريمة تدور أحداثه في السبعينيات في قرية صغيرة هادئة بجوار البحر، حيث تقع امرأتان بشكل غير متوقع في مخطط تهريب عالي المخاطر.

badland-hunters-2024.title: Badland Hunters
badland-hunters-2024.synopsis: بعدما يحوّل زلزال مميت "سول" إلى أرض قاحلة ينعدم فيها القانون، ينطلق صياد شجاع لإنقاذ مراهقة من براثن طبيب مجنون اختطفها.

parasakthi-2026.title: Parasakthi
parasakthi-2026.synopsis: In a time of civil disobedience in the erstwhile Madras state, a ruthless intelligent officer turns up with a duty to track down rebels. Chezhian and his brother Chinndurai are of different personalities, one a hardworking fireman, the other a rebel. A deadly game of cat and mouse ensues as Chezhian is forced to abandon his peaceful ways to protect his people and takes on the mighty forces, culminating in a fierce battle for justice.

tu-meri-main-tera-main-tera-tu-meri-2025.title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
tu-meri-main-tera-main-tera-tu-meri-2025.titleEn: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
tu-meri-main-tera-main-tera-tu-meri-2025.originalTitle: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri 2025
tu-meri-main-tera-main-tera-tu-meri-2025.synopsis: When a carefree NRI wedding planner and a headstrong novelist collide during a wild summer in Croatia, sparks fly in ways neither expected. What begins as playful clashes soon transforms into something deeper – only to be tested when love, family, and tradition pull them in opposite directions.

mary-kom-2014.title: Mary Kom
mary-kom-2014.synopsis: A chronicle of the life of Indian boxer 'Mary Kom' who went through several hardships before audaciously accomplishing her ultimate dream.

veeraaraju-1991-2025.title: Veeraaraju
veeraaraju-1991-2025.synopsis: A brave fisherman fights a corrupt politician to defend his village on Nellore Sea Shore after coastal displacement. His rebellion ignites a revolution that spreads beyond Krishna Lanka, showcasing courage and sacrifice.

ghaath-2023.title: Ghaath
ghaath-2023.synopsis: An unsparing psychological portrait of the civil war that has been raging in central India for over 50 years. Set in the middle of the jungle, we see what happens to perpetrators and victims whose lives are marked by a constant proximity to violence and death.

saripodhaa-sanivaaram-2024.title: Saripodhaa Sanivaaram
saripodhaa-sanivaaram-2024.synopsis: Set in Sokulapalem, bound by a promise to his mother, Surya, an LIC agent leads a normal life on six days, maintains a careful ledger of everyone made him angry,unleashing his anger only on Saturdays, solely for justifiable reasons. A tragic incident pits him on a collision course with the ruthless and borderline-manic cop Daya.

good-bad-ugly-2025.title: Good Bad Ugly
good-bad-ugly-2025.synopsis: On electric vehicles explores their environmental impact, industry challenges, and global implications, focusing on China's EV dominance and cybersecurity concerns.

asuran-2019.title: Asuran
asuran-2019.synopsis: A family from the underprivileged class is on the run after the teenaged son kills a rich man from the upper caste. Can the pacifist father be able to save his hot-blooded son?

anand-sreebala-2024.title: Anand Sreebala
anand-sreebala-2024.synopsis: Follows the missing person case of Merin Joy and how an ordinary man with a tragic past gets wrapped in the investigation.

bougainvillea-2024.title: Bougainvillea
bougainvillea-2024.synopsis: A family entangled in a police investigation surrounding the mysterious disappearance of tourists in Kerala.

do-patti-2024.title: Do Patti
do-patti-2024.synopsis: A puzzling investigation leads a no-nonsense cop down a dark path involving the vicious rivalry between twin sisters and the volatile man they both love.

sarfira-2024.title: Sarfira
sarfira-2024.synopsis: A young man from a remote village dreams of launching his own airline service. However, he must overcome several obstacles and challenges in order to be successful in his quest.

yevam-2024.title: Yevam
yevam-2024.synopsis: In the small town of Vikarabad, Soumya, a rookie cop eager to prove herself, is paired with a sincere Officer Abhiram, to unravel the sinister motives of  a serial offender Yugandhar, who targets young fan girls of stars, which turns out to be more dangerous than she imagined.

anweshippin-kandethum-2024.title: Anweshippin Kandethum
anweshippin-kandethum-2024.synopsis: A team of four expert policemen go through extreme trials and tribulations to find the killer of a young woman.

tufang-2023.title: Tufang
tufang-2023.synopsis: Tufang is a Punjabi movie starring Guri and Rukshaar Dhillon in the lead.

the-good-boy-2026.title: The Good Boy
the-good-boy-2026.synopsis: Tommy, a volatile 19-year-old, revels in drugs, parties and violence. After getting separated from his friends on a drunken bender, he is abducted by a shadowy figure. He wakes to find himself imprisoned in the basement of a remote Yorkshire house, inhabited by a very strange family. But what unfolds is not what he could possibly expect.

you-can-t-win-2026.title: You Can’t Win
you-can-t-win-2026.synopsis: The true-crime story of legendary outlaw Jack Black, whose 1926 memoir became an unlikely bestseller upon its release and later inspired generations of counter-cultural writing.

feel-my-voice-2026.title: Feel My Voice
feel-my-voice-2026.synopsis: A teenager, the only hearing member of a deaf family, finds her voice and learns to believe in herself through her passion for singing.

taylor-swift-the-eras-tour-the-final-sho.title: Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour – The Final Show
taylor-swift-the-eras-tour-the-final-sho.titleEn: Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour – The Final Show
taylor-swift-the-eras-tour-the-final-sho.originalTitle: Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour – The Final Show 2025
taylor-swift-the-eras-tour-the-final-sho.synopsis: تايلور سويفت | جولة العصر | العرض الأخير يمثّل الحفلة الأخيرة المصوّرة في فانكوفر.

women-of-the-night-2001.title: Women of the Night
women-of-the-night-2001.synopsis: Three entwined stories of love, lust, danger and revenge.

the-divorce-lawyer-2025.title: The Divorce Lawyer
the-divorce-lawyer-2025.synopsis: When emotionally abandoned wife Zahra Jones seeks the help of divorce attorney Joshua Wright, she becomes the target of a twisted obsession, forcing her and her husband Mark to survive against a man determined to ruin her life.

hysteria-2025.title: Hysteria
hysteria-2025.synopsis: A film shoot takes a dark turn when the burning of a Quran throws the crew into turmoil. Caught in accusations, intern Elif is drawn into a dangerous game of secrets and lies, finding herself at the heart of an all-absorbing conspiracy.

zombies-4-dawn-of-the-vampires-2025.title: Zombies 4: Dawn of the Vampires
zombies-4-dawn-of-the-vampires-2025.synopsis: A new adventure dawns for Zed and Addison when their summer road trip takes an unexpected detour, landing them in the middle of yet another monster rivalry: Daywalkers vs. Vampires. Tensions flare when Zed and Addison find themselves acting as camp counselors between the two opposing supernatural factions. With the help of Eliza and Willa, they must convince sworn enemies Nova and Victor to try to unite their warring worlds before an even greater threat endangers them all.

muori-di-lei-2025.title: Muori di lei
muori-di-lei-2025.synopsis: Luca is a forty-year-old teacher experiencing a relationship crisis with his wife, Sara, who is much wealthier than him. During the lockdown, Luca finds himself a bystander in the life of his new neighbor, Amanda, and decides to bridge the distance between them, with disastrous consequences.

diabolique-1996.title: Diabolique
diabolique-1996.synopsis: تتعاون زوجة وعشيقة معلم مدرسة قاسي في محاولة مخطط لها وتنفيذها بعناية لقتله. تسير الخطة بشكل جيد حتى يختفي الجسم ، الذي تم إغراقه بشكل استراتيجي. يبدأ التوتر في إخبار المرأتين عندما يبدأ محقق شرطة متقاعد يبحث في الاختفاء لمجرد نزوة يعتقد أنهما يعرفان أكثر مما يقولان ، ولا تتحسن حالتهما العقلية عند رؤية ضحيتهما ، على ما يبدو على قيد الحياة وكذلك من قبل أحد التلاميذ.
diabolique-1996.tagline: امرأتان. رجل واحد. يمكن أن يكون الجمع بين القتل.

scandalo-1976.title: Scandalo
scandalo-1976.synopsis: In wartime France, Pharmacist Eliane begins a torrid affair with her shop assistant Armand, but she soon becomes dominated by him. He demands more and more from her, humiliating her and putting her family at risk.

largo-winch-ii-2011.title: Largo Winch II
largo-winch-ii-2011.synopsis: Propelled to the head of the W Group after the death of his adoptive father, Largo Winch decides, to everyone's surprise, to sell it, and use the proceeds to create an ambitious humanitarian foundation. But on the very same day, he finds himself accused of crimes against humanity by a mysterious witness. To prove his innocence, Largo will have to retrace the steps of his past life, in the heart of the Burmese jungle.

cast.name: นภคปภา นาคประสิทธิ์
นิรุตติ์ ศิริจรรยา

delicatessen-1991.title: Delicatessen
delicatessen-1991.synopsis: في عالم ما بعد نهاية العالم، سكان شقة فوق محل الجزّار يحصلون أحيانا على قطعة لحوم نادرة تُعدّ من الأطعمة الفاخرة. شاب جاء حديثاً إلى المدينة يقع في حبّ ابنة الجزّار، مما يثير صراعات داخل عائلتها التي تريد الاستفادة منه لأغراض تجارية أخرى.

faultline-2024.title: Faultline
faultline-2024.synopsis: Two sisters find new information about the crime that tore them apart 20 years ago.

the-year-between-2022.title: The Year Between
the-year-between-2022.synopsis: Inspired by true events, college sophomore Clemence Miller is coming home to the suburbs and a bedroom in her family's basement. After dropping out of school with a newly diagnosed mental illness, she now faces the challenges of bipolar disorder, the responsibilities of adulthood, and her damaged relationships with family and friends. Clemence struggles to figure out what it means to heal without driving everyone around her… well, crazy. As if reckoning with everything and everyone she has taken for granted wasn’t enough, Clemence has to wrestle with the thought that on top of it all, she might also just have a really bad personality.

hunters-on-a-white-field-2024.title: Hunters on a White Field
hunters-on-a-white-field-2024.synopsis: Three friends decides to spend a long weekend in a remote cabin, deep within the Swedish woods to go hunting. However, one day all animals vanish without a trace and the forest turns eerily quiet. Obsessed with the idea of hunting, they decide to let the hunt go on, somehow.

the-new-year-that-never-came-2024.title: The New Year That Never Came
the-new-year-that-never-came-2024.titleEn: The New Year That Never Came
the-new-year-that-never-came-2024.originalTitle: The New Year That Never Came 2024
the-new-year-that-never-came-2024.synopsis: The New Year That Never Came is a tragicomedy whose action takes place in a single day, before the revolution of 1989, in which the characters search for normality, safety, love, freedom and meaning in an absurd world.

عرض-ilana-glazer-human-magic-2024.title: Ilana Glazer: Human Magic
عرض-ilana-glazer-human-magic-2024.synopsis: Ilana Glazer's unfiltered stand-up special dives into life's down and dirty truths, from painfully awkward high school years to navigating parenthood as a stoner mom.

the-only-girl-in-the-orchestra-2023.title: The Only Girl in the Orchestra
the-only-girl-in-the-orchestra-2023.titleEn: The Only Girl in the Orchestra
the-only-girl-in-the-orchestra-2023.originalTitle: The Only Girl in the Orchestra 2023
the-only-girl-in-the-orchestra-2023.synopsis: يحتفي هذا الوثائقي القصير بعازفة الكونترباص الرائدة "أورين أوبراين"، وهي أول امرأة تصبح عضوًا بدوام كامل في أوركسترا "نيويورك" الفيلهارمونية.

the-martini-shot-2023.title: The Martini Shot
the-martini-shot-2023.synopsis: This existential comedic drama follows an ailing film director as he begins to shoot what he believes to be his final work of art. What starts out as a normal film for him changes dramatically as the deterioration of his health progresses. The result being a fascinating exploration of mortality and one’s profound effect on the world.

2022-erik-kivis-da.title: Erik Kivisüda
2022-erik-kivis-da.synopsis: Erik is convinced he has a stone for a heart. That’s why he doesn’t mind that his parents have no time for him, or that he is bullied at school, or that he has no real friends. When his family moves to a villa they inherited, he is confronted by Maria whom Erik's parents want to kick out along with her father. Maria refuses to move and promises to make Erik's life a living hell. As a last attempt to defeat Erik, Maria goes to look for her mother who disappeared two years ago. Together they end up on a fantastical journey to the In-Between-World and Erik learns how hard it really is to wear a heart of stone.

making-scents-of-love-2023.title: Making Scents of Love
making-scents-of-love-2023.synopsis: A woman falls "head over heels" for a guy after accidentally spilling a vial of her new fragrance, that also might happen to be a love potion.

the-jack-in-the-box-rises-2024.title: The Jack in the Box Rises
the-jack-in-the-box-rises-2024.titleEn: The Jack in the Box Rises
the-jack-in-the-box-rises-2024.originalTitle: The Jack in the Box Rises 2024
the-jack-in-the-box-rises-2024.synopsis: When a creepy Jack-in-the-Box is discovered and opened on the grounds of an exclusive girls' school, six brave students soon enter a fight to the finish against the unleashed demon.

adam-the-first-2024.title: Adam the First
adam-the-first-2024.synopsis: Adam, a 14-year-old boy travels across the country to meet a series of men who could be his father after finding a letter with a list of names and addresses.

illusions-for-sale-the-rise-and-fall-of-.title: Illusions for Sale: The Rise and Fall of Generation Zoe
illusions-for-sale-the-rise-and-fall-of-.titleEn: Illusions for Sale: The Rise and Fall of Generation Zoe
illusions-for-sale-the-rise-and-fall-of-.originalTitle: Illusions for Sale: The Rise and Fall of Generation Zoe 2024
illusions-for-sale-the-rise-and-fall-of-.synopsis: This documentary follows the rise and fall of Generation Zoe, a spiritual coaching network hiding the most unusual scam in Argentina's history.

monolith-2022.title: Monolith
monolith-2022.synopsis: A desperate young journalist turns to podcasting to salvage her career, but her rush to make headlines leads her to an alien conspiracy.

you-re-not-alone-2023.title: You’re Not Alone
you-re-not-alone-2023.synopsis: When his flight is delayed coming home from a business trip, Keith Mitchell has to leave his daughter Alexis, who’s stuck at home under house arrest, alone for the night. Once Keith is finally in the air with full bars of WiFi, he notices a stranger enter the house on his security system. Unable to warn Alexis when the WiFi suddenly cuts out, Keith sits helpless from 30,000 feet in the air while his daughter fights for her life.

the-great-escaper-2023.title: The Great Escaper
the-great-escaper-2023.synopsis: يهرب بيرنارد جوردان من منزل لرعاية المسنين؛ في سبيل حضور احتفالات الذكرى الـ70 لغزو نورمندي في فرنسا.

flamin-hot.title: Flamin' Hot
flamin-hot.synopsis: يدور العمل حول السيرة الذاتية لريتشارد مونتانيز، الذي كان له الفضل الأول في تقديم منتج تشيتوس، واستطاع غزو الأسواق في ظاهرة عالمية كبيرة كأشهر وجبة خفيفة عل الإطلاق.

how-to-become-a-mob-boss.title: How to Become a Mob Boss
how-to-become-a-mob-boss.originalTitle: How to Become a Mob Boss
how-to-become-a-mob-boss.synopsis: يستكشف هذا الدليل الإرشادي الغامض والساخر قصص صعود أشهر زعماء العصابات في التاريخ وسقوطهم وأساليبهم المستخدمة لتحقيق النجاح.

joe-pickett.title: Joe Pickett
joe-pickett.synopsis:
تدور القصة حول جو بيكيت، وهو حارس بيئي لحماية الحياة البرية والغابات، ينتقل مع عائلته إلى بلدة ريفية صغيرة في ولاية وايومنج بحثاً عن حياة هادئة.

تنقلب حياته رأساً على عقب عندما يجد جثة صياد مقتولاً في باحة منزله. وبسبب استقامته الشديدة ورفضه التغاضي عن الخطأ، يبدأ جو في التحقيق بنفسه، ليجد نفسه في مواجهة شبكة معقدة من الفساد والمؤامرات والمجرمين المحليين، مما يضع حياته وحياة عائلته في خطر حقيقي وسط الطبيعة الجبلية القاسية.

moana-2.title: Moana 2
moana-2.synopsis: بعد تلقيها نداء من أسلافها، تسافر "موانا" و"ماوي" إلى بحار "أوقيانوسيا" البعيدة.

physical.title: Physical
physical.synopsis: تعيش ربة المنزل Sheila Rubin صراعًا داخليًا في منزلها بكاليفورنيا خلال فترة الثمانينات حيث تنازع هواجس داخلية شرسة، إلا أن كل هذا يتغير عندما تكتشف تمارين الأيروبيك وتنطلق في رحلة نحو تطوير الذات والنجاح.

sebastian-fitzeks-therapy.title: Sebastian Fitzeks Die Therapie
sebastian-fitzeks-therapy.synopsis: إثارة نفسية مشوقة مبنية على رواية الكاتب "سيباستيان فيتزيك" الأكثر مبيعاً. لا يوجد شهود، ولا آثار، ولا جثة. تختفي "جوسي" ابنة الـ13 عاماً للطبيب النفسي الشهير "فيكتور لارنز" في ظروف غامضة. بعد عامين، تظهر امرأة غامضة، تُجبر "فيكتور" على التعامل مع اختفاء ابنته وتدفعه إلى أقصى حدوده النفسية.

sisyphus-the-myth.title: 시지프스 : the myth
sisyphus-the-myth.synopsis: بعد وقوع حادثة غامضة يصعب تفسيرها، يكتشف مهندس عبقري أسرار العالم الخطيرة، ويلتقي بامرأة من المستقبل جاءت للبحث عنه.

the-old-oak.title: The Old Oak
the-old-oak.synopsis: يدور العمل حول مستقبل الحانة الأخيرة المتقبية في قرية بشمال إنجلترا تُسمى بأولد أوك، وكيف تحولت المنطقة المحيطة إلى موقعًا مثاليًا للاجئين السوريين.
